name: ccmms-render-mobile-mongodb
description: CCMMS mobile-first Student/Admin/Staff app with Express API, MongoDB Atlas, JWT auth and Render deployment.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=student && npm run build --workspace=admin && npm run build --workspace=staff
scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && node --check backend/config.mjs && node --check backend/db.mjs && node --check backend/auth.mjs && node --check backend/data.mjs && node --check backend/firebase.mjs && node --check backend/media.mjs && node --check backend/mail.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build
